title: Digest for 5 to 11 October 2026
summary: Selected changes from the Cursor changelog, Claude Code and Codex release notes, and the GitHub changelog. Each item quotes the source wording and links to it.

items.title: Remote control for local agents
items.text: You can now see and reply to the local agents running on your computer from the Cursor iOS app.

items.title: Claude Code v2.1.292
items.text: Added an `effort` parameter to the Agent tool, so Claude runs a sub-agent at the effort level you ask for

items.title: Claude Code v2.1.293
items.text: Added Claude Haiku 5.5 (`claude-haiku-5-5`), now the default Haiku model on the Anthropic API — 1M context, $0.10/$0.50 per Mtok ($0.50/$2.50 for prompts over 100K)

items.title: Claude Code v2.1.294
items.text: Fixed `prompt` and `agent` hooks written as instructions (such as "Block commands that...") allowing what they should block

items.title: Claude Code v2.1.295
items.text: Added `onFailure: "block"` for command and HTTP hooks: a hook that can't start, times out, or exits with an unexpected code blocks the action instead of letting it through

items.title: Claude Code v2.1.296
items.text: Added an `allow_large` option to the Read tool so Claude can read a text file past the usual size limits in one call when it needs the whole file and the context has room

items.title: Codex 0.161.0
items.text: GPT-6.1 Sol is now the default model in the bundled and Amazon Bedrock catalogs.

items.title: Codex 0.162.0
items.text: Add tools for creating and listing managed Git worktrees from trusted local projects when the worktrees feature is enabled.

items.title: GPT-6.1 Sol Ultrafast in Codex and ChatGPT Work
items.text: Ultrafast mode speeds up token generation with GPT-6.1 Sol in Codex and ChatGPT Work. Ultrafast is available on Pro $500 and eligible Enterprise and Edu plans.

items.title: Codex 0.162.1
items.text: Fixed a TUI crash when asynchronous questions contain multiple lines, preserving line breaks and complete hyperlink destinations.

items.title: Claude Haiku 5.5 in GitHub Copilot
items.text: Claude Haiku 5.5, Anthropic’s newest lightweight model, is now generally available in GitHub Copilot.

items.title: Copilot code review: New organization billing options and controls
items.text: This release adds new billing and license controls for Copilot code review admins

items.title: GitHub Copilot weekly releases: October 5
items.text: Limit agents’ access to files, networks, and credentials with local sandboxing, now generally available in Copilot CLI, the Copilot app, and VS Code sessions using Agent Host.

items.title: New controls and chat improvements in Copilot for JetBrains
items.text: This update brings more control over default models and MCP server in GitHub Copilot for JetBrains.
